# Bulltrace

> Bulltrace is an investment research and portfolio tracking platform for retail investors. For any publicly traded stock, it gives a plain-language, jargon-free analysis of business quality, growth, valuation, risk and investment potential — each kept independent rather than blended into one opaque number — plus a 5-year fundamentals-based price scenario. It takes no position on whether to buy or sell.

## What Bulltrace does

- **Stock analysis**: for any ticker, a quality score (0-100, independent of price), a plain-language verdict, and a 5-year entry-price/margin-of-safety estimate. A deeper breakdown (quality, momentum, valuation, risk, potential — five independent dimensions, each with its own score and plain-language explanation) is one click away.
- **Portfolio tracking**: manual positions, or a direct read-only sync with a connected Trading 212 account (positions, cash and activity), with per-account currency handling.
- **Watchlist**: follow stocks and see the same quality verdict at a glance.
- **ETF pages, a market radar, an earnings calendar, and a beginner-oriented "Aprende" section.**
- A single-ticker checker at bulltrace.app/start: paste a ticker, get an instant verdict with no account required.

## The analysis engine

Bulltrace evaluates every stock across five deliberately independent dimensions — never merged into a single blended score, because a business can be excellent and still be a bad purchase at today's price, or mediocre and still be cheap without that making it a good buy:

1. **Calidad (Quality, 0-100)** — return on invested capital (ROIC, or ROE for banks/insurers) versus the company's cost of capital, plus margins, cash generation and balance-sheet strength. Computed without looking at the share price at all.
2. **Crecimiento (Growth/Momentum)** — whether revenue, margins, profit and free cash flow are improving or deteriorating versus the company's own recent history, not a one-quarter snapshot.
3. **Valoración (Valuation, 0-100)** — today's price against today's earnings/cash via several sector-relative multiples at once (P/E, EV/EBITDA, P/FCF, etc., chosen by business model), plus the implied return at the current price.
4. **Riesgo (Risk)** — a checklist of concrete categories (leverage, dilution, customer concentration, growth dependency, accounting-quality flags and more), each marked as confirmed, potential, none detected, or not evaluable with available data — never silently treated as "no risk" just because a data point is missing.
5. **Potencial (Potential, 0-100)** — a weighted composite of the four dimensions above, with hard caps: a demanding valuation or high risk level puts a ceiling on the score regardless of how strong the other dimensions are.

Separately, a **5-year discounted-cash-flow scenario model** (conservative / central / optimistic) projects per-share value five years out and the maximum price an investor could pay today to demand a 15%/year return — built only from revenue, margins, reinvestment, net debt and share count. It never uses the stock's own past price history or analyst price targets as an input, specifically to avoid the reflexive bias of a price projection that just follows where the stock has already moved. When the available data can't support a reliable projection, the UI says so (N/D, with a plain-language reason) instead of showing an invented number.

## Data sources

Financial data comes directly from SEC EDGAR filings, Yahoo Finance and Finnhub — not from a third-party's pre-digested summary. Every figure a user sees can be traced back to the originating filing.

## Pricing

Bulltrace is freemium.
- **Free** (0€, no card required): quality verdicts and the 5-year projection on every stock, quality notes on stocks and ETFs, a watchlist of up to 20 stocks, unlimited stock/ETF search.
- **Pro**: 14,99 €/month, or 9,99 €/month billed annually (119,99 €/year) — adds multi-currency portfolio tracking, an unlimited watchlist, and unlimited daily discovery. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

## Who it's for

Retail investors who want to understand a stock's actual business quality and valuation before buying — without market-jargon, without a hidden "buy/sell" recommendation, and without one black-box number standing in for five different questions that don't always point the same way.

## Key pages

- [Home / product entry point](https://bulltrace.app)
- [Quick single-ticker checker](https://bulltrace.app/start): no account required
- [Pricing](https://bulltrace.app/pricing)
- [About / methodology](https://bulltrace.app/about): the five dimensions and the 5-year scenario model, explained in full
- [FAQ](https://bulltrace.app/faq)

A given stock's own page lives at `https://bulltrace.app/stock/{TICKER}`, with a deeper breakdown at `https://bulltrace.app/stock/{TICKER}/analisis`.

## Founder

Bulltrace is built by Pablo (@pabloinvesting_), an independent investor and indie developer who also publishes equity research through Hawthorne & Fletcher Research using a related proprietary framework (the Invest Data Score).
